scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A pattern needs context
scenes.caption: Asha traces a small fictional transfer network. One account receives money and soon sends a similar amount onward. Another collector does the same while organising a documented group purchase. The visible pattern alone does not establish wrongdoing.
scenes.dialogue: What does the transaction record actually show?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Two similar paths
scenes.caption: The prepared five-minute rule flags both the unresolved pass-through path and the documented group collector. A payment record shows an amount, time and route; it does not reveal a person’s intent, authorisation or complete financial context.
scenes.dialogue: A review flag must not become an allegation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Test an innocent explanation
scenes.caption: Compare the timestamps and source references with independently supplied receipts. Keep the group-purchase explanation where supported and mark the unresolved path for authorised review. Missing evidence and alternative explanations stay visible.
scenes.dialogue: The same flag can match a legitimate activity.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the conclusion
scenes.caption: Should Asha label every flagged account criminal, publish the network, or state the observed pattern and evidence gaps while testing the documented benign explanation?
scenes.dialogue: Investigate the hypothesis without accusing a person.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A cautious ledger
scenes.caption: Asha records two flagged intermediaries: one has supplied benign context and one remains unresolved. She does not call the unresolved case a confirmed fraud or calculate a meaningful accuracy score from unknown truth labels.
scenes.dialogue: A count is only as informative as its labels.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the pattern lab
scenes.caption: Trace the synthetic edges, run the transparent rule and explain what the benign match teaches. No real account number, person or transaction is analysed, and no external investigation is performed.
scenes.dialogue: Keep the flag separate from the verdict.
